rules.statement: claim types (fact, decision, gotcha, finding): checks run in this order and the first failing one decides: G2 length 24-300 Unicode scalar values (too_short / too_long), G3 single line (multi_line), G8 list marker (multi_claim), G6 log text (log_text), G4 at most 2 sentences (multi_claim), G5 complete sentence (not_sentence), G7 not truncated (truncated), G9 path share <= 40 % (log_text); reason null = passes
rules.node_type: explicit node_type wins; archetype decision -> decision, gotcha -> gotcha, workflow -> procedure with steps else fact; then exact category tokens (split on - _ : / space, lowercase): deny {log, trace, debug, output, temp} -> no_type, {decision, adr} -> decision, {gotcha, pitfall, warning} -> gotcha, {procedure, howto, runbook} -> procedure with steps else fact; otherwise fact
rules.refs: reference grammar of G10; `server: syntax_only` = Hive checks the grammar only (it has no checkout); engines also check the target at HEAD
rules.procedure: title 8-120 chars, one line, starts like a sentence (final punctuation optional); 1-20 steps of 8-300 chars, single line, no log text, not truncated; 0-10 commands {shell sh|pwsh|cmd, cmd 1-500 chars, cwd_hint <= 120}; failures -> procedure_shape, a bad title -> not_sentence
